name: AIR
summary: Drum on nothing. Swing the box like a stick: forward the hi-hat, left the kick, right the snare, back the open hat, every hit on the beat. Tap REC and make a sound: it is a pad. Hold REC and play: a loop of whole bars, four of them stacked.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: The strokes are read from the gyro, confirmed by the accelerometer. Which way is forward depends on how the box sits in your hand: FEEL > FORWARD and FEEL > SIDES turn it round; FEEL > SWING SETUP learns how hard you swing.
status_note: Swung on a board on 2026-10-22 (the stroke detector was tuned on it). The rework of 2026-10-23 (the beat that is always there, loops in bars, the tap that samples, CONFIRM, SWING SETUP) passes the simulator and has not been on a board yet.
